snapshot.label: Contact
snapshot.value: Damien Langley — Head of Agency Sales

snapshot.label: Relationship
snapshot.value: Warm but cooling — logins down 60% YoY

snapshot.label: Main risk
snapshot.value: Will not renew without proof that the QSR + Retail patches are getting fresh signal

snapshot.label: Main opportunity
snapshot.value: Upsell to Prospector Predictions for the agency desk; Damien has mentioned interest twice

prospect_focus.label: Industries & verticals
prospect_focus.value: QSR (top priority), Retail, and Banking. Looking for challenger brands — Damien explicitly avoids tier-1 ad spenders; wants to sell against agency incumbents. Mentioned Boost Juice, Guzman y Gomez, and Bank Australia as the kinds of accounts he wants intel on.

prospect_focus.label: Agency vs Direct
prospect_focus.value: Direct patch. Network Ten sells direct to brand teams — agencies are a relationship layer he manages but not who he sells to. He's flagged Initiative and OMD as the two agencies he wants insight on when their clients change brief.

prospect_focus.label: Region / state focus
prospect_focus.value: National coverage but with VIC/NSW emphasis. Has explicitly deprioritised WA and Tas — doesn't have a seller in those markets. SA only matters when a national QSR rollout is in play.

blockers.label: Data accuracy / freshness
blockers.value: Raised in Apr 2026 dialogue — flagged 3 Coles contacts as out of date and one Guzman y Gomez contact who'd left the business 6 months earlier. Said 'if I can't trust the names, I can't pitch off the platform'.

blockers.label: Time / proactive use
blockers.value: Has said twice in the last 2 months he's 'too busy running pitches to log in'. Last login was 9 Apr. Wants insights pushed to him rather than having to hunt for them.

blockers.label: Other blockers
blockers.value: Pricing pushback in Feb 2026 — said the per-seat cost was hard to justify against the lower number of inbound leads from the platform vs his other vendors. Pushed for a usage-based pilot, no response logged.

steps.step: Alex to deliver 5 QSR challenger-brand cards by 15 Apr 2026
steps.evidence: 16 Apr dialogue: 'Damien confirmed receipt of the 5 cards — flagged Boost Juice as the standout, asked for 3 more like it.'

steps.step: Damien to circulate the cards to the QSR sales pod and report which generated a meeting booking
steps.evidence: No mention of circulation in dialogue since 16 Apr. Apr 28 catch-up notes say Damien was 'in pitch mode all week, hadn't got to it'.

steps.step: Alex to send pricing comparison vs Roy Morgan and IBIS by end of April
steps.evidence: Apr 22 dialogue: pricing sent for Roy Morgan only. IBIS comparison still outstanding.

meeting_moves.title: Open with the QSR cards — confirm they worked before pushing for the circulation follow-through

rows.label: Evidence
rows.value: Damien rated 4 of the 5 cards 'genuinely useful' (16 Apr) — proof the format lands when targeted.

rows.label: Question
rows.value: Of the 5 cards I sent, which one would you re-use today to open a cold conversation?

rows.label: Example
rows.value: The Boost Juice card mapped a Series B raise to their FY27 brand campaign window — the kind of timing intel his desk needs.

rows.label: Objection
rows.value: I've been too busy to circulate them properly.

rows.label: Response
rows.value: Let me push the next batch directly into your team's Slack — you don't need to forward anything. Want me to set that up?

meeting_moves.title: Confront the data freshness complaint — show what changed since April

rows.label: Evidence
rows.value: Damien named 4 specific contacts as stale in Apr. Bring evidence those names have since been refreshed (last_updated dates).

rows.label: Question
rows.value: If I show you the 4 contacts you flagged are now current, does that change your read on the rest of the dataset?

rows.label: Example
rows.value: Coles VP Marketing record updated 28 Apr; Guzman y Gomez Head of Brand updated 12 May.

rows.label: Objection
rows.value: Four contacts being right doesn't mean the next four will be.

rows.label: Response
rows.value: Agreed — would a quarterly 'flag and verify' channel for his patch fix the trust gap? It's how we've handled it for the Sportsbet account.

meeting_moves.title: Surface the pricing pilot proposal he raised in Feb — get a yes/no before renewal conversation starts

rows.label: Evidence
rows.value: Damien asked about usage-based pricing in Feb — no response logged. Renewal is in 4 months; this needs to be either offered or killed before the renewal call.

rows.label: Question
rows.value: You floated a usage-based pilot in Feb — is that still something you'd consider, or has the budget conversation moved on?

rows.label: Example
rows.value: We've trialled a usage-based model with one other agency desk — happy to share what the pricing looked like and the activity threshold.

rows.label: Objection
rows.value: Procurement won't accept anything other than a flat per-seat fee.

rows.label: Response
rows.value: Understood — then let's stop talking about pricing and instead build a usage proof-point that justifies the current per-seat in the renewal paper. That's the real question.
